options.text: It was the first Earth-observation satellite designed, tested and operated entirely by Brazil
It was the first satellite launched from Alcântara
It was the first satellite to photograph the Amazon

explanation: Before it, Brazil’s observation satellites were joint projects, such as CBERS.

prompt: Why was Amazonia-1 launched in India and not at Alcântara?

options.text: Brazil had no rocket big enough, and Alcântara couldn’t handle the PSLV
Because Alcântara is far from the equator

explanation: Brazil had no rocket of the right size, and Alcântara, built for the 19.7-metre VLS, had no facilities for the 44.4-metre PSLV.
